sentences.zh: 在新南威尔士州，联盟党正与“一国党”对峙，与此同时，一个新的威胁正在崛起：独立派。

sentences.en: The opposition’s struggle is creating an opportunity for progressive independents who are boosted by shrewd political operator Chris Minns Get our daily political email , free app or daily news podcast The New South Wales Coalition is facing a renewed threat to its heartland seats on Sydney’s north shore.
sentences.zh: 反对党的斗争正在为进步派独立人士创造机会，他们得到了精明的政治操盘手Chris Minns的支持。订阅我们的每日政治电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客。新南威尔士州联盟党正面临着对其在悉尼北岸核心选区的席位的新威胁。

sentences.zh: 得克萨斯州死囚在超过一小时的处决过程中尖叫。

sentences.en: This prolonged execution comes weeks after Christa Pike survived the lethal injection of the same drug.
sentences.zh: 这次长时间的处决发生在克里斯塔·派克（Christa Pike）在注射了同一种药物后幸存数周之后。

items.title: Texas execution took over an hour as staff struggled to find vein; Reinaldo Dennes moaned about pain

sentences.en: Texas execution took over an hour as staff struggled to find vein; Reinaldo Dennes moaned about pain.
sentences.zh: 得克萨斯州的一次处决持续了一个多小时，因为工作人员很难找到静脉；雷纳尔多·丹尼斯（Reinaldo Dennes）呻吟着喊痛。

sentences.en: The same day Dennes was given lethal injection, Florida carried out a record-breaking 20th execution of the year.

items.title: Afghanistan restrictions prevent pregnant women from seeking medical help

sentences.en: Afghanistan restrictions prevent pregnant women from seeking medical help.
sentences.zh: 阿富汗的限制措施阻碍了孕妇寻求医疗帮助。

sentences.en: Aid and development agencies in Afghanistan warned on Friday of an escalating “assault” on the rights and freedoms of women and girls that is preventing growing numbers from accessing vital medical care.
sentences.zh: 阿富汗的援助和发展机构周五警告称，对妇女和女童权利和自由的“侵犯”正在加剧，这正导致越来越多的人无法获得至关重要的医疗服务。

items.title: COP31: Countries demand stronger climate deal as talks in Antalya reach final day

sentences.en: COP31: Countries demand stronger climate deal as talks in Antalya reach final day.
sentences.zh: COP31：随着安塔利亚谈判进入最后一天，各国要求达成更强有力的气候协议。

sentences.en: A group of countries from Europe, Africa, Latin America and the Pacific has challenged the proposed COP31 agreement, demanding explicit action on fossil fuels and stronger climate finance.
sentences.zh: 来自欧洲、非洲、拉丁美洲和太平洋地区的一批国家对拟议的COP31协议提出质疑，要求就化石燃料问题采取明确行动，并加大气候融资力度。

sentences.en: With the summit due to close on Friday, tensions are rising as activists warn the talks are headed for failure, and negotiators search for a deal that nearly 200 governments can accept.
sentences.zh: 随着峰会将于周五闭幕，紧张局势正在加剧，因为活动人士警告称，谈判正走向失败，而谈判代表则在寻求近200个政府都能接受的协议。

items.title: WFP plans to assist 91 million in 2027 as hunger crisis deepens

sentences.en: WFP plans to assist 91 million in 2027 as hunger crisis deepens.
sentences.zh: 随着饥饿危机的加剧，世界粮食计划署计划在2027年向9100万人提供援助。

sentences.en: The World Food Programme (WFP) will require $12.1 billion to assist 91 million people next year but warned that millions more will go hungry as funding shortfalls continue and another global food crisis looms.
sentences.zh: 世界粮食计划署（WFP）明年将需要121亿美元来援助9100万人，但该署警告称，由于资金持续短缺，且又一场全球粮食危机迫在眉睫，还有数百万计的人将陷入饥饿。

items.title: Shattered playgrounds and freezing classrooms: Inside Ukraine’s deadliest year for children

sentences.en: Shattered playgrounds and freezing classrooms: Inside Ukraine’s deadliest year for children.
sentences.zh: 被摧毁的游乐场和冰冷的教室：乌克兰儿童遭遇最致命一年的幕后故事。

sentences.en: Amid the ruins of a twice-bombed Kyiv kindergarten as a day-long power cut continued, the UN Children’s Fund (UNICEF) on Friday highlighted the dangers to youngsters enduring another brutal winter in Ukraine, as child casualty numbers rise to record levels.
sentences.zh: 周五，在基辅一所被轰炸两次的幼儿园废墟中，联合国儿童基金会（UNICEF）强调了乌克兰儿童在又一个严酷的冬季所面临的危险，而儿童伤亡人数已升至创纪录水平。与此同时，该地正经历着长达一天的停电。

items.title: West Bank: Record settler attacks mar olive harvest as UN urges Israel to protect farmers

sentences.en: West Bank: Record settler attacks mar olive harvest as UN urges Israel to protect farmers.
sentences.zh: 约旦河西岸：定居者袭击事件创下新高，影响橄榄采摘，联合国敦促以色列保护农民。

sentences.en: Israeli settlers have carried out more than 400 attacks causing casualties or property damage during this year’s olive harvest in the occupied West Bank – more than in any previous season, UN agencies and humanitarian NGOs said on Friday.
sentences.zh: 联合国机构和人道主义非政府组织周五表示，在今年被占领的约旦河西岸的橄榄收获季节，以色列定居者发动了400多起造成人员伤亡或财产损失的袭击，超过了以往任何一个收获季节。

items.title: ‘You will not be alone’: General Assembly President tells Rohingya refugees after genocide ruling

sentences.en: ‘You will not be alone’: General Assembly President tells Rohingya refugees after genocide ruling.
sentences.zh: “你们不会孤立无援”：大会主席在种族灭绝案裁决后对罗兴亚难民表示。

sentences.en: A day after the UN’s highest court found that Myanmar had committed genocide against the Rohingya, the President of the General Assembly visited the refugee camps in Cox’s Bazar, Bangladesh, urging the world to turn the landmark judgement into action.
sentences.zh: 联合国最高法院裁定缅甸对罗兴亚人实施种族灭绝的一天后，大会主席访问了孟加拉国科克斯巴扎尔的难民营，敦促世界将这一具有里程碑意义的判决付诸行动。

items.title: ‘Weak and dizzy’: the secretive ICE force-feeding tactics that ended a Cuban father’s hunger strike

sentences.en: ‘Weak and dizzy’: the secretive ICE force-feeding tactics that ended a Cuban father’s hunger strike.
sentences.zh: “虚弱和头晕”：移民和海关执法局（ICE）秘密的强行喂食手段结束了一位古巴父亲的绝食抗议。

sentences.en: Exclusive: Luis Alejandro Cora Pérez says in messages to Guardian from inside Texas facility pain of force-feeding caused him to break strike The text message that came from inside the Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) detention center was stark: “I have spent five days eating regular food.
sentences.zh: 独家报道：路易斯·亚历杭德罗·科拉·佩雷斯在发给《卫报》的信息中表示，强行喂食的痛苦迫使他结束绝食。这条短信来自美国移民和海关执法局（ICE）拘留中心内部，内容令人震惊：“我已经吃了五天正常食物。

sentences.en: If I don’t eat it, they put the tube in me to feed me.” A Cuban asylum seeker, Luis Alejandro Cora Pérez, 32, said in messages to the Guardian this month that he was still weak and dizzy after three months without eating, but that he had broken his hunger strike because being force-fed was just too painful.
sentences.zh: 如果我不吃，他们就会给我插管喂食。” 32岁的古巴寻求庇护者路易斯·亚历杭德罗·科拉·佩雷斯（Luis Alejandro Cora Pérez）本月在给《卫报》的讯息中表示，在禁食三个月后，他仍然感到虚弱和头晕，但他已经结束了绝食，因为被强行喂食太痛苦了。

sentences.en: Continue reading..

items.title: California investigates Nvidia over whether chip exports ended up in China

sentences.en: California investigates Nvidia over whether chip exports ended up in China.
sentences.zh: 加州正在调查Nvidia是否向中国出口芯片。

sentences.en: State attorney says scandal ‘raises bright red flags’ and aims to find out if company misled investors California has served an investigative subpoena on Nvidia after a scandal that prompted the departure of co-founder and longtime chief executive Jensen Huang.
sentences.zh: 州检察官表示，该丑闻“亮起了鲜红的警示灯”，其目的是查明该公司是否误导了投资者。加利福尼亚州已向英伟达发出调查传票，此前的一桩丑闻导致了联合创始人兼长期首席执行官黄仁勋的离职。

sentences.en: Rob Bonta, the US state’s attorney general, issued the subpoena as part of an investigation into whether exports of the California-based company’s advanced semiconductor chips ended up in China, contravening US restrictions.
sentences.zh: 美国加利福尼亚州司法部长罗布·邦塔（Rob Bonta）发出传票，作为一项调查的一部分，以查明这家总部位于加利福尼亚州的公司出口的高级半导体芯片是否最终流入中国，从而违反了美国的限制规定。

sentences.en: Continue reading..

items.title: California’s coastal communities on alert as biggest waves in years hit state

sentences.en: California’s coastal communities on alert as biggest waves in years hit state.
sentences.zh: 加利福尼亚州的沿海社区处于警戒状态，因为该州遭遇了多年来最大的海浪。

sentences.en: Hazard warnings issued throughout week after powerful swells and waves of more than 9 metres recorded Multiple coastal hazard warnings were issued this week across California as successive areas of low pressure generated powerful swells and large breaking waves for coastal communities.
sentences.zh: 在记录到超过9米的巨浪和涌浪后，整个一周都发布了灾害警报。本周，加利福尼亚州各地发布了多项沿海灾害警报，因为连续的低压区给沿海社区带来了巨浪和汹涌的破浪。

sentences.en: Beaches and piers were closed last weekend as large waves crashed into California’s coastline.
sentences.zh: 上周末，由于大浪冲击加州海岸线，海滩和码头被关闭。

sentences.en: Offshore National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration buoys recorded wave heights of greater than 30ft (9 metres) last Friday.
sentences.zh: 美国国家海洋和大气管理局的近海浮标上周五记录到超过30英尺（9米）的浪高。

sentences.en: The Monterey, California, buoy recorded a wave height of 34.1ft, which would make it the highest reading in 30 years.
sentences.zh: 加利福尼亚州蒙特雷的浮标记录到的浪高为34.1英尺，这将是30年来的最高读数。

sentences.en: Coastal warnings extended from last weekend through this week, with alerts extending until Friday night.
sentences.zh: 沿海地区的警告从上周末一直延续到本周，预警将持续至周五晚间。

sentences.en: Waves of 10-18ft are expected, with local sets of 18-22ft for San Luis Obispo county beaches and Santa Barbara county central coast beaches.
sentences.zh: 预计将出现10-18英尺的浪潮，圣路易斯-奥比斯波县的海滩和圣巴巴拉县的中部海岸海滩将出现18-22英尺的局部浪潮。

sentences.en: These Pacific storm systems are also bringing unsettled conditions across the western US, with heavy rain, mountain snow, and strong winds through the coming days.
sentences.zh: 这些太平洋风暴系统还将给美国西部带来不稳定天气，未来几天将有大雨、山区降雪和大风。

sentences.en: Already, record-breaking rainfall affected San Fransisco on Wednesday, with heavy rain also causing 32,000 customers to lose power in Sacramento.
sentences.zh: 周三，破纪录的降雨已经影响了旧金山，大雨还导致萨克拉门托有3.2万用户停电。

sentences.en: Into this weekend, a further area of low pressure will bring considerable amounts of moisture for southern Oregon and northern California.
sentences.zh: 本周末，另一个低压区将为俄勒冈州南部和加利福尼亚州北部带来大量水分。

sentences.en: By Sunday night, more than 100mm (4in) of rain is expected in places, with further snowfall for areas such as Donner Pass across the northern Sierra Nevada mountains.
sentences.zh: 预计到周日晚间，部分地区降雨量将超过100毫米（4英寸），多纳山口等内华达山脉北部地区将迎来更多降雪。

items.title: Vape users hospitalised after losing consciousness, prompting public health warning in New South Wales

sentences.en: Vape users hospitalised after losing consciousness, prompting public health warning in New South Wales.
sentences.zh: 新南威尔士州多名电子烟使用者因失去知觉而被送医，引发公共卫生警告。

sentences.en: Testing confirms presence of etomidate, a strong and fast-acting sedative used as a general anaesthetic overseas but not registered for medical use in Australia Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Three people who lost consciousness and were hospitalised in New South Wales after using certain vapes have tested positive for the unregulated anaesthetic agent etomidate, health officials said.
sentences.zh: 检测结果证实了依托咪酯的存在，这是一种强效且起效迅速的镇静剂，在海外被用作全身麻醉剂，但在澳大利亚未获准用于医疗。订阅我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客。卫生官员表示，在新南威尔士州，有三人在使用某些电子烟后失去知觉并被送医，其检测结果显示含有未受监管的麻醉剂依托咪酯。

sentences.en: NSW health on Friday issued a public warning about vape liquids containing etomidate, a strong and fast-acting sedative used as a general anaesthetic overseas but not registered for medical use in Australia.
sentences.zh: 新南威尔士州卫生部周五发布了关于含有依托咪酯的电子烟油的公众警告。依托咪酯是一种强效且起效迅速的镇静剂，在海外被用作全身麻醉剂，但在澳大利亚未获准用于医疗用途。

items.title: Race to be next UN secretary general exposes divisions among world powers

sentences.en: Race to be next UN secretary general exposes divisions among world powers.
sentences.zh: 争夺下一任联合国秘书长之位的角逐凸显了世界大国之间的分歧。

sentences.en: Debate about dominance of permanent five members could reignite if major powers block Costa Rican frontrunner The race to become the next UN secretary general could reach a decisive moment on Friday when a UN security council vote is likely to reveal whether the Costa Rican frontrunner for the post would be blocked by the big powers.
sentences.zh: 如果大国阻挠哥斯达黎加的领先候选人，关于常任理事国主导地位的争论可能会再次燃起。联合国下一任秘书长的角逐可能在周五迎来决定性时刻，届时联合国安理会将进行投票，很可能揭示大国是否会阻挠哥斯达黎加的领先候选人。

sentences.en: If so, the setback will reignite a debate about the dominance of the permanent five (P5) members at the United Nations.
sentences.zh: 如果是这样，这一挫折将再次引发关于联合国五个常任理事国（P5）主导地位的争论。

sentences.en: Rebeca Grynspan, an economist and UN insider who is from a family of Polish-Jewish wartime refugees to Costa Rica, has been in the lead in all but one of the eight straw polls of the 15 UN security council members since the first secret ballot was held on 30 July.
sentences.zh: 自7月30日举行第一次无记名投票以来，在联合国安理会15个成员国进行的八次非正式投票中，经济学家兼联合国内部人士Rebeca Grynspan在除一次外的所有投票中均名列前茅。她来自一个在战时逃往哥斯达黎加的波兰裔犹太难民家庭。

sentences.en: Each member goes down the list of candidates, casting an “encourage”, “discourage” or “no opinion” vote for each candidate.
sentences.zh: 每位成员都会浏览候选人名单，对每位候选人投出“鼓励”、“不鼓励”或“无意见”的票。

items.title: nginx2root: Five new nginx vulnerabilities, and how Cloudflare protects origins from the worst of them

sentences.en: nginx2root: Five new nginx vulnerabilities, and how Cloudflare protects origins from the worst of them.
sentences.zh: nginx2root：五个新的nginx漏洞，以及Cloudflare如何保护源服务器免受其中最严重的漏洞的侵害。

sentences.en: On November 18, 2026, F5 and nginx.org disclosed ten vulnerabilities in nginx.
sentences.zh: 2026 年 11 月 18 日，F5 和 nginx.org 披露了 nginx 中的十个漏洞。

sentences.en: Five of them, detailed by the Xint research team and published under the name nginx2root , are memory corruption flaws that an unauthenticated attacker can use to crash an nginx worker or, per Xint's research, run commands on the server.
sentences.zh: 其中有五个漏洞由Xint研究团队进行了详细说明，并以nginx2root的名义发布。这些漏洞是内存损坏漏洞，未经身份验证的攻击者可以利用这些漏洞使nginx工作进程崩溃，或者根据Xint的研究，在服务器上运行命令。

sentences.en: Xint also found a Linux kernel bug that turns that foothold into root on the host, including from inside a Docker container.
sentences.zh: Xint还发现了一个Linux内核漏洞，该漏洞会将立足点转变为主机上的root权限，包括从Docker容器内部。

sentences.en: Other teams found the two HTTP/2 bugs independently: F5 also credits Rapid7, Wiz Research and Ikotas Labs for CVE-2026-123007, and Metnir, Wiz Research, and Palo Alto Networks Unit 42 for CVE-2026-123633.
sentences.zh: 其他团队也独立发现了这两个 HTTP/2 漏洞：F5 还感谢 Rapid7、Wiz Research 和 Ikotas Labs 发现了 CVE-2026-123007，并感谢 Metnir、Wiz Research 和 Palo Alto Networks Unit 42 发现了 CVE-2026-123633。

sentences.en: nginx is an HTTP web server that also serves as reverse proxy, content cache, load balancer, TCP/UDP proxy server, and mail proxy server.
sentences.zh: Nginx 是一款 HTTP Web 服务器，同时还用作反向代理、内容缓存、负载均衡器、TCP/UDP 代理服务器和邮件代理服务器。

sentences.en: nginx runs a large share of the world's web servers, so this is a patch-now event.
sentences.zh: nginx 运行着世界上很大一部分的 Web 服务器，因此这是一个需要立即修补的事件。

sentences.en: But if your nginx server is reachable only through Cloudflare's proxy, attackers cannot reach the vulnerable code paths for the most serious of these bugs, giving you protection while you update your servers.
sentences.zh: 但是，如果您的nginx服务器只能通过Cloudflare的代理访问，那么攻击者就无法触及这些最严重漏洞的易受攻击代码路径，从而在您更新服务器时为您提供保护。

sentences.en: Here is where Cloudflare stands, what that protection covers, where it stops, and how the bugs work.
sentences.zh: 本文将介绍 Cloudflare 的立场、该保护的覆盖范围、其局限性以及漏洞的运作方式。

sentences.en: The short version Cloudflare's edge is not affected.
sentences.zh: 简而言之，Cloudflare 的边缘服务不受影响。

sentences.en: Much of the proxy that handles customer traffic at our edge now runs on FL2, written in Rust.
sentences.zh: 目前，处理客户流量的大部分代理都运行在FL2上，并且是用Rust编写的。

sentences.en: We reviewed the parts still built on our heavily modified nginx fork against all five bugs before disclosure, and an update closing the related code paths finished rolling out globally before the vulnerabilities were published.
sentences.zh: 在披露之前，我们对照所有五个漏洞检查了仍基于我们经过大量修改的nginx分支构建的部分，并在漏洞发布之前完成了在全球范围内推出关闭相关代码路径的更新。

sentences.en: Xi, Putin and Trump outline priorities that include UN reform, boosting oil supplies and ‘protection of diplomatic immunity’ China, Russia and the US say they have agreed a peace statement after an unprecedented trilateral summit, but the declaration made no mention of the wars in Ukraine and Iran caused by two of the participants.
sentences.zh: 习近平、普京和特朗普概述了优先事项，其中包括联合国改革、增加石油供应和“保护外交豁免权”。中国、俄罗斯和美国表示，在一次前所未有的三方峰会后，他们已就一项和平声明达成一致，但该声明未提及由其中两个与会国引发的乌克兰和伊朗战争。

sentences.en: The US president appeared to close his eyes for roughly 10 seconds on Thursday.
sentences.zh: 美国总统周四似乎闭眼了大约10秒钟。

sentences.en: As his eyes closed, Trump’s head tilted downward, and his hands remained clasped in front of him.
sentences.zh: 当他闭上眼睛时，特朗普的头向下方倾斜，双手仍交叉握在身前。

items.title: The best things in open source are built together

sentences.en: The best things in open source are built together.
sentences.zh: 开源领域最优秀的事物都是共同打造的。

sentences.en: In 2026, public contributions on GitHub soared to 2.5 billion , more than double last year s total of 1.12 billion.
sentences.zh: 2026年，GitHub上的公开贡献飙升至25亿次，是去年11.2亿次总数的两倍多。

sentences.en: It goes to show how open source remains a powerful mechanism for developers to build, share, and grow communities.
sentences.zh: 这表明，开源仍然是开发者构建、分享和发展社区的强大机制。

sentences.en: Open source is how I began my GitHub journey.
sentences.zh: 开源是我开启 GitHub 之旅的方式。

sentences.en: I contributed to Processing Foundation by adding alt-text to images on the p5.js website.
sentences.zh: 我为Processing Foundation做出了贡献，在p5.js网站上的图片中添加了替代文本。

sentences.en: This was the first time I felt included in a software development space as someone with a background in traditional fine arts and design.
sentences.zh: 这是我第一次作为一名具有传统美术和设计背景的人，感到自己被接纳在软件开发领域。

sentences.en: It was the first time I made a fork, opened a pull request, and merged code on a repo that wasn t mine.
sentences.zh: 这是我第一次分叉代码、发起拉取请求，并将代码合并到不属于我的代码库中。

sentences.en: Working at GitHub, you hear stories like mine everywhere.
sentences.zh: 在 GitHub 工作，您到处都能听到像我这样的故事。

sentences.en: Open source is foundational to us not only as a business but also for who we are as the people who build it!
sentences.zh: 开源不仅是我们作为企业的基石，也是我们作为构建开源的人的基石！

sentences.en: We recently launched two new open source projects to share with the community: Replica , an open-source design harness, and the Open Source Accessibility Framework .
sentences.zh: 我们最近推出了两个新的开源项目，与社区分享： Replica ，一个开源设计工具，以及开源无障碍框架。

sentences.en: I attended John Maeda s session with Qianqian Ye, Director of Creative Technology at Processing Foundation, at GitHub Universe titled, Sketching with code in the age of AI.
sentences.zh: 我参加了John Maeda与Processing Foundation创意技术总监Qianqian Ye在GitHub Universe上举办的名为“在人工智能时代用代码进行草图绘制”的讲座。

sentences.en: This session talked about the power of the open source community and reminded me how important it is to our developer ecosystem.
sentences.zh: 本场会议讨论了开源社区的力量，并提醒我它对我们的开发者生态系统是多么重要。
